messages:
Maya (product): Quick heads-up: GenStream v1 is GA on Hosted API. This unifies token streaming + tool frames into a single endpoint and introduces structured event frames. Rolling out to regions over ~24h. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/genstream

Rohan (eng-runtime): TL;DR tech: single POST /v1/genstream supports stream:true, functions[], and emits event frames with kind: token|tool_call|tool_result|error. Clients that only listen for newline tokens continue to work.

Sofia (devex): SDK update: @redwood/sdk-js v3.2.0 and @redwood/sdk-py v3.2.0 add .streamEvents() helpers and built-in event parsing. Please update sample apps.

Alex (infra): New per-request header to control tool behavior: X-RW-Tool-Enable: on|off|org-default. Example (curl):

```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/genstream \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-RW-Tool-Enable: on' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-gen-3","input":"Inspect repo and call tools","stream":true,"functions":[{"name":"list_files","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```

Rohan (eng-runtime): Note: org-level tool execution remains opt-in by default for new orgs. If you set header on a request but the org is not enabled, the stream will emit a tool_blocked event. This avoids accidental remote actions.

Nina (support): New error code TOOL_BLOCKED and event messages will show up in audit logs. Support KB: Console -> Security -> Tool Audit. We'll add troubleshooting steps to the internal runbook.

DeployBot: rollout:genstream-v1 -> canary:us-west-2 \u2705 started at 1795001145, est global completion 1795008745.

Maya (product): Action items: 1) Update quickstarts to SDK v3.2.0, 2) Verify org tool settings for enterprise customers, 3) Add example showing X-RW-Tool-Enable header. Reply here when done.

Sofia (devex): I'll push patches to the example repos and update the tutorial this afternoon.

Alex (infra): Observability: added genstream.event_count and genstream.tool_events metrics to Console. Keep an eye on P95 streaming latency for the next 48h.

Rohan (eng-runtime): Tip: if customers see schema_mismatch tool_result events, confirm the function schema and that the SDK's validation is up-to-date. Reach out to #eng-runtime for logs.

Maya (product): We'll coordinate a short blog and targeted emails to enterprise accounts after metrics stabilize. Thanks team! :tada:
